resources.string: Next import/update only. Reapply in Themes.

Switch between prepared light/dark copies when the system mode changes, instead of a live selector per icon. Smoother app launches; the desktop page and open apps are kept. Takes effect on the next import.
Brightness selection applies to converted APK / classic ZIP artwork. Native MTZ / icons ZIPs keep their own behavior.
Follow system uses the pack\'s light/dark artwork where the launcher supports it. Other icons may stay light.
Uses light artwork, dimmed to 214/255 at night like ColorOS Default style. This is separate from dark artwork; night switching needs launcher support.
Next import preview: light system above, dark system below, using the selected brightness.
Supported ColorOS calendars, clocks and Monet colors update live. Other artwork is converted for installed apps. Import again after adding apps or updating a pack.
